title: XlsformFixDescriptor
description: The structured, machine-applicable fix a cht-conf form ticket's code-gen phase emits at .cht-agent/xlsform-fix.json. A deterministic orchestrator step validates it, applies the edits to a sandbox copy of the workbook, converts offline, and asserts the compiled bind against `expect` before staging for HC2. The LLM never touches the binary .xlsx.

version.description: Descriptor schema version. Only 1 is supported.

form.description: Base form name; resolves to forms/app/<form>.xlsx and .xml. No path separators, dots, or traversal.

edits.description: Surgical cell edits applied in order to the workbook.

column.description: Header name of the column to match on (typically name).

value.description: Exact value the match column must equal.

groupPath.description: Optional ancestor group-name path (outermost first) to disambiguate a repeated name.

column.description: Header name of the column to write (e.g. relevant).

value.description: New cell value in XLSForm syntax. Written verbatim.

expect.description: The dev-phase oracle: what the OFFLINE-CONVERTED XML must show. Compared against the real converted output, not the LLM's own edit.

nodeset.description: Absolute XForm nodeset of the target bind (e.g. /data/danger_signs).

relevant.description: The relevant expression the converted bind must carry after the fix.

siblingsUnchanged.description: When true (default), every other top-level group bind must be byte-invariant vs the pre-edit conversion.

rationale.description: One paragraph for the HC2 reviewer and the operator report.
